name: B.K. School of Professional and Management Studies, Gujarat University

programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Grant-in-Aid, full-time
programs.feeNote: Official admission page states 'Rs. 6,500/- per year' (academic year not stated); total = 6,500 x 2 years = Rs 13,000 (derived). Hostel and other charges not stated.
programs.intakeNote: Intake 120 per B.K. School admission page.
programs.placementNote: Official Final Placement page lists recruiters only; no salary statistics published.

selectionProcess.name: CMAT (NTA)
selectionProcess.detail: Graduation with at least 50% (SC/ST 45%); CMAT score mandatory as per Government of Gujarat norms.

selectionProcess.name: ACPC Gujarat online registration, merit list and seat allotment
selectionProcess.detail: Admission entirely through the ACPC portal (gujacpc.admissions.nic.in); selected candidates then report in person to the B.K. School admin office.

keyDates.notes: ACPC dates for AY 2027-28 not yet published. For reference, the AY 2026-27 ACPC MBA/MCA cycle ran: registration 25 May-30 Jun 2026; final merit list and Round-1 choice filling 14-17 Jul 2026; Round-1 allotment 21 Jul 2026; CMAT-2026 mandatory.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
